name: Volume-Based Densification
definition: A density control method where the volume of each Gaussian primitive (ellipsoid) dictates the refinement process, addressing shortcomings of gradient-based ADC in high-frequency regions.
summary: Volume-Based Densification is a 3D Gaussian Splatting refinement strategy that uses ellipsoid volume and covariance condition number to manage primitive density, addressing gradient-based control failures in sparse regions.
